headerDisplay: Every Airthings monitor on the account becomes one air-quality accessory. Apple Home shows the readings it understands. Eve shows radon, pressure, and the rest. The Good / Fair / Poor tile is radon, on every monitor that reports radon.
footerDisplay: The client secret is stored in the Homebridge configuration file, like every Homebridge credential, and is never written to the log. Create the client at the Airthings consumer dashboard. The [documentation](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-myairthings#readme) explains each setting.

clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: From an API client on the Airthings consumer dashboard. AIRTHINGS_CLIENT_ID overrides this.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: From an API client on the Airthings consumer dashboard. AIRTHINGS_CLIENT_SECRET overrides this.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to read sensors. Default 300. Airthings allows 120 requests an hour for the whole account. Values below 60 use 60.

co2DetectedThreshold.title: CO₂ Detected Threshold (ppm)
co2DetectedThreshold.description: Carbon dioxide at or above this value is detected. Default 1000, which is Airthings' poor band. The air-quality tile follows radon.

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Logs radon, CO₂, temperature, and sample age for each monitor after every poll, as debug lines. Homebridge shows them only in debug mode.

diagnosticsInterval.title: Diagnostics Interval (seconds)
diagnosticsInterval.description: 0 is off. Otherwise a health line at this interval, up to 3600 seconds. Values from 1 to 29 use 30.

pagerdutySignals.title: Send Signals to PagerDuty
pagerdutySignals.description: Write this plugin's alert conditions to homebridge-pagerduty's signal store. Then allow homebridge-myairthings to page in homebridge-pagerduty's settings. Needs Node 22.13 or later.
